title: Parametric cabinet-handle layout files
engineering: True-size drill layout for 96, 128 and 160 mm handle pitches with centerline, setbacks and two-axis scale bars.
physical_check: Measure both bars on the print, then transfer one complete hole pair and fit a handle on scrap.

title: Printed PCB dock with one OpenLog carrier
engineering: SparkFun DEV-13712 carrier with 0.35 mm pocket allowance, 12 mm card service travel and 7.5 mm projected camera margin.
physical_check: Fit a populated DEV-13712 and re-seat it ten times. Confirm the card clears the holder and photos preserve framing.

title: Drawer-slide alignment pair
engineering: Mirrored slide locators hold a pair of 450 mm rail coupons at 410 mm reference spacing, with 4 mm clamp access clearance.
physical_check: Measure spacing at the two ends before and after installing an actual matched slide pair with its intended screws.

title: Device-specific repair screw tray
engineering: Six labeled fastener wells with isolated transport lids. The lid opening over a wall is 0.6 mm.
physical_check: Load known service fasteners, close and invert the tray a dozen times, then check migration and retrieval effort.

title: Fixed-angle split-keyboard supports
engineering: Wingless Moonlander-envelope keyboard support pair at 13.73°. Assumed typing positions retain 32.5 mm landing margin.
physical_check: Transfer underside contact zones and plug clearances from both actual keyboard halves, then test typing and slipping across the target supports.

title: Low-profile 4WD inspection rover, dry indoor use
engineering: Dry indoor 4WD inspection cart envelope with a 6 mm floor threshold, 6.8 mm overhead margin and a manual recovery slot.
physical_check: Push an unpowered loaded cart through a 75 mm roof jig and across a 6 mm threshold. Then check tether recovery and visibility with the installed camera.

title: USB parts-counting and kit-check scale
engineering: Interval-based parts counter distinguishes all 18–22 part lots in 135 synthetic mass and sensor-corner scenarios.
physical_check: Weigh known lots of 18–22 parts across three actual supplier lots, including count-19 samples, tare resets and several tray positions.

title: Aquarium automatic top-off unit
engineering: Automatic top-off logic traces cover dry reservoir, stuck-low demand, high cutoff, normal cycling and a restart with retained fault.
physical_check: Use a bench tank with a catch basin. Measure dose and cutoff under disconnected sensors, stuck low demand, overfill switch activation and power cycling.

title: Auto-traverse pickup coil winder
engineering: Discrete pickup winder command model delivers 6,000 turns with 0.08–0.09 mm pitch and 53 layer reversals.
physical_check: Use sample bobbins and sacrificial wire. Measure turn count, edge buildup and tension after repeated reversals.

title: Reusable shrimp tray photo mount
engineering: Fixed tray photo stand with modeled nearest specular spot 16.7 mm outside the sample edge after ±5 mm placement deviations.
physical_check: Use an empty tray and representative wet surfaces to check repeated centering, preview flare and glare outside the central plane.

title: Adjustable tabletop phone arm
engineering: Two-link adjustable phone arm with 252 mm horizontal reach and modeled 5.54 mm droop for a 240 g phone.
physical_check: Hang the declared load at full reach and measure clamp movement and arm droop over ten minutes, then cycle all locking controls.

title: Raised-line neighborhood orientation map
engineering: Raised desk teaching layout with five distinct matching landmark symbols and a 16.8 mm minimum ridge-to-symbol gap.
physical_check: Ask intended learners to match every landmark to the separated key and log any symbol or line they confuse.
